{{Quote|We're picking up a vessel, pretty big one too, coming out of lightspeed in the system.|[[Darryn Thyte]], to [[Kaiya Adrimetrum]]|<ref name="TKR" />}}
The '''Yvara system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Blue Swirl]] of the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector's]] [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yvara]] orbited a blue-white [[Star/Legends|star]] in the system. The [[Constellation/Legends|constellation]] known as the [[Horns of Waryl]] was visible as an inverted pyramid from Yvara.
